title: Histologic analyses of flapless ridge preservation in sockets with buccal dehiscence defects using two alloplastic bone graft substitutes
authors: Naenni N, Bienz SP, Jung RE, Hämmerle CHF, Thoma DS. Clin Oral Investig. 2019; 23(9):3589-3599.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of alloplastic materials rendered greater horizontal dimensions and a more favorable maintenance of the ridge profile” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
